name: Armadillo
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats mostly insects

features.claim: An armadillo has a leathery armor shell covering it.
features.quote: Living armadillos are characterized by a leathery armor shell and long, sharp claws for digging.

features.claim: An armadillo has long, sharp claws that it uses for digging.
features.quote: Living armadillos are characterized by a leathery armor shell and long, sharp claws for digging.
They have short legs, but can move quite quickly.

features.claim: An armadillo is about 75 cm long, counting its tail.
features.quote: The average length of an armadillo is about 75 cm (30 in), including its tail.

features.claim: The armor is made of plates of bone covered in small overlapping scales called scutes.
features.quote: The armor is formed by plates of dermal bone covered in relatively small overlapping epidermal scales called "scutes" which are composed of keratin.

features.claim: Most armadillos have stiff shields over the shoulders and hips, with bands between them across the back and sides.
features.quote: Most species have rigid shields over the shoulders and hips, with a number of bands separated by flexible skin covering the back and flanks.

features.claim: Extra armor covers the top of the head, the upper parts of the limbs, and the tail.
features.quote: Additional armor covers the top of the head, the upper parts of the limbs, and the tail.

features.claim: The underside of an armadillo is never armored; it is covered with soft skin and fur.
features.quote: The underside of the animal is never armored and is simply covered with soft skin and fur.

features.claim: An armadillo has five clawed toes on its hind feet.
features.quote: They have five clawed toes on their hind feet, and three to five toes with heavy digging claws on their fore feet.

features.claim: An armadillo has three to five toes with heavy digging claws on its front feet.
features.quote: They have five clawed toes on their hind feet, and three to five toes with heavy digging claws on their fore feet.

features.claim: An armadillo's skin can glow under ultraviolet light.
features.quote: The skin of an armadillo can glow under ultraviolet light.
